name: Hubble Space Telescope
summary: Pointing and jitter from HST observation logs (_jit 3-second averages + _jif summaries).
time_basis: seconds since exposure start (jit 'Seconds', 3 s averages)
train_label: Isolation Forest on jitter windows (split by exposure)
evaluate: alert counts and reviewed outcomes (no verified fault labels)

dataset.next_action: Prepare once on a machine with the source data: python -m spaceml.missions.prepare hubble --from <folder of *_jit.fits / *_jif.fits>  (or --download <dataset ids>)

fields.name: files
fields.label: HST observation-log files or rootnames
fields.placeholder: e.g. abcd01xyj_jit.fits abcd01xyj_jif.fits  (or just the rootname)
fields.help: Find them in the MAST Portal: search your HST observation, open its products and filter for 'jit' / 'jif'.

auto_install.label: Download the 12 newest public Hubble jitter logs from MAST
